title: Module 6 — Past tense, tourism, holidays and personal experience
description: Talk about trips, holidays and past experiences using the Pretérito Perfeito Simples, both regular and the key irregular verbs, plus the adverbs and superlatives that colour a story.

topics.title: Travel and tourism
topics.brief: Vacation and travel vocabulary: hotels, reservations, sightseeing and tourist attractions (monumento, praia, castelo, visita guiada).
topics.avoid: past tenses (introduced later in this module), subjunctive.

topics.title: Holidays and traditions
topics.brief: Holidays, festivals and traditions in Portugal; greetings and giving gifts for occasions (Feliz Natal!, Boas Festas!, Parabéns!, Um presente para ti).
topics.known: Module 1 to 5 grammar; everyday-1 phrase set.
topics.avoid: past tenses (introduced later in this module), subjunctive.

topics.title: Simple past — regular verbs
topics.brief: Pretérito Perfeito Simples of regular -ar, -er and -ir verbs (falei, comi, parti); past time markers (ontem, na semana passada, há um ano, no ano passado).
topics.avoid: subjunctive, conditional, irregular PPS verbs (next topic).

topics.title: Simple past — irregular verbs
topics.brief: Pretérito Perfeito Simples of the key irregular verbs (ir, ser, estar, ter, fazer, ver, dar, saber, poder); life-experience constructions já / ainda não / nunca + PPS; the recent-past construction acabar de + infinitivo.

topics.title: Biography and life experience
topics.brief: Talking about biographical facts and past events (Nasci em…, Mudei-me para…, Trabalhei como…) and personal life experience, combining the regular and irregular PPS.

topics.title: Manner adverbs and the absolute superlative
topics.brief: Manner adverbs formed with -mente (rapidamente, felizmente, facilmente); the absolute superlative (quentíssimo, lindíssimo, baratíssimo) for emphasis in a story.
